article.title: City Audit Finds Delays in Bridge Repairs
article.text: A city audit found that required bridge repairs were delayed for two years. The transport department says procurement rules caused the delay. The audit states that the department waited nine months before opening the procurement process. The article argues that management failures, rather than procurement rules alone, caused the delay.
